assumptions.title: path is identity (keyed state, identity runs)
assumptions.status_note: Upheld by construction; no dedicated falsification test.

assumptions.title: content identified by hash (snapshot comparison)
assumptions.status_note: Imposed and tested; finite model bounds allow collisions the real hash function must not produce.

assumptions.title: filesystem wins (converged direction, sweep, rescan heals)
assumptions.owner: sweep (per root) plus rescan reconciliation (sidecar identity in the snapshot - model prescribes, code lacks)

assumptions.title: derived store is pipeline-private (walk roots disjoint)
assumptions.owner: deployment layout (walk roots disjoint from derived store)
assumptions.status_note: Assumed true; no check that walk roots never cover the derived store.

assumptions.title: quiescence (safety invariants asserted at settled state)
assumptions.status_note: Safety invariants are asserted at settled states; scheduling fairness is delegated to QUINT-ASS-7.

assumptions.title: user enables backstop scans at regular intervals
assumptions.status_note: Assumed operating condition: the user enables the periodic backstop and it runs at regular intervals. Nothing verifies the setting or the interval. The watcher's Flag::Rescan trigger exists only while the watcher is enabled; with the watcher off, the backstop is the sole trigger.
